destinations.title: Appointment
destinations.description: A visit to a provider: the reason, a scan of the card, and the pin.

destinations.title: Asset
destinations.description: A tagged thing you keep: its photo, condition, custodian, and where it sits.

destinations.title: Class roll
destinations.description: Attendance for a class, recorded by subject code rather than a full name.

destinations.title: Cleaning
destinations.description: A cleaning pass: the area, photos before and after, and who did it.

destinations.title: Client invoice
destinations.description: An invoice you sent: its code, the customer, the amount, and a scan.

destinations.title: Delivery proof
destinations.description: Proof a delivery was made: tracking code, recipient code, photo, and pin.

destinations.title: Donation
destinations.description: A gift received: donor code, campaign, amount, and the receipt.

destinations.title: Expense
destinations.description: A cost you paid: who received it, what it was for, and the receipt.

destinations.title: Field lead
destinations.description: A person or company you met in the field: a scan of the card and the next step.

destinations.title: Fuel stop
destinations.description: A fill-up: the vehicle, the pump numbers, the station, and the receipt.

destinations.title: Grocery item
destinations.description: Something bought at a store: scan the barcode, note the price, and pin the store.

destinations.title: Bill
destinations.description: A vendor bill or receipt, scanned.

destinations.title: Clip
destinations.description: A short video of something a photo does not show, such as a drip.

destinations.title: Home
destinations.description: The building: address, pin, and a photo of the front.

destinations.title: Room
destinations.description: A room, with a door tag, a photo, and its condition.

destinations.title: Snag
destinations.description: A problem in the house: photo, pin, and priority.

destinations.title: Incident
destinations.description: Something that went wrong: what happened, how serious, a photo, and the pin.

destinations.title: Inspection
destinations.description: A check of a tagged item: pass or fail, the finding, a photo, and the pin.

destinations.title: Fault
destinations.description: A fault on tagged equipment: pin, photo, and a video of the problem.

destinations.title: Job
destinations.description: A call: the job code, the customer, and the arrival pin.

destinations.title: Order
destinations.description: The work order, scanned, with its code.

destinations.title: Part
destinations.description: A part used on the job, identified by its code.

destinations.title: Meal
destinations.description: A meal: what kind, the place, a photo, and what it cost.

destinations.title: Meeting
destinations.description: A meeting in the field: who was there, a photo of the board, and the next step.

destinations.title: Mileage
destinations.description: A drive: why you went, where it started and ended, and the miles.

destinations.title: Package
destinations.description: A parcel that arrived: tracking code, condition, photo, and where it was.

destinations.title: Payment in
destinations.description: Money that came in, with the reference and the invoice it pays.

destinations.title: Purchase order
destinations.description: An order you placed: the PO code, the vendor, quantities, and a scan.

destinations.title: Refund
destinations.description: Money returned to you, with the original reference and the receipt.

destinations.title: Return shipment
destinations.description: Something you sent back: the return code, the reason, and a photo.

destinations.title: Service record
destinations.description: Work done on something you own: the tag, the vendor, the cost, and the paperwork.

destinations.title: Shift note
destinations.description: The handoff at the end of a shift: the code, a photo, and what the next person should know.

destinations.title: Batch
destinations.description: A made batch: lot code, photo, and where it is stored.

destinations.title: Day
destinations.description: A market day: where the stall is, and a photo of it.

destinations.title: Invoice
destinations.description: A supplier invoice, scanned.

destinations.title: Item
destinations.description: A good for sale: SKU, photo, and price.

destinations.title: Slip
destinations.description: A sale: scan the item code and note the quantity.

destinations.title: Stock count
destinations.description: A count of what is in a bin: scan the barcode and record the quantity.

destinations.title: Clip
destinations.description: A short video from the site, with its pin.

destinations.title: Ground
destinations.description: A study site: name, pin, and a photo.

destinations.title: Note
destinations.description: A field note tied to a subject code, not a full name.

destinations.title: Sample
destinations.description: A sample: its vial or bag code, where it was found, and a photo.

destinations.title: Sheet
destinations.description: A scanned page or map, with its record code.

destinations.title: Temperature
destinations.description: A temperature check: the place, the reading, and a photo of the gauge.

destinations.title: Time entry
destinations.description: Hours on a job: the job code, the task, and the site.

destinations.title: Moment
destinations.description: A short video of a moment, with where it was.

destinations.title: Ticket
destinations.description: A ticket or reservation, with its code and a scan of the paper.

destinations.title: Trip
destinations.description: The trip itself: where it starts, who is along, and the day it opened.

destinations.title: Visit
destinations.description: A place visited: pin, photo, rating, and whether to come back.

destinations.title: Visitor
destinations.description: Someone on site: badge code, host, purpose, and a photo of the badge.

destinations.title: Warranty
destinations.description: A product you can still claim on: its code, serial, photo, and receipt.

destinations.title: Work sample
destinations.description: A page of work tied to a subject code, with a photo or scan and a score.

destinations.title: Workout
destinations.description: A session: the activity, how long, a photo, and where you were.

scenarios.name: House file
scenarios.description: A home walkthrough. House holds the building and its rooms. Fix holds snags, bills, and clips. Each workspace is one spreadsheet. Codes can be scanned or tapped. Date fills itself.

scenarios.name: Job round
scenarios.description: A site call. Job holds the call and the scanned order. Gear holds faults and parts. Each workspace is one spreadsheet. Codes can be scanned or tapped. Date fills itself.

scenarios.name: Stall book
scenarios.description: A market stall. Goods holds items and batches. Market holds the day, sales slips, and invoices. Each workspace is one spreadsheet. Codes can be scanned or tapped. Date fills itself.

scenarios.name: Study walk
scenarios.description: Field notes. Site holds the ground and samples. Record holds notes, scanned pages, and clips. Each workspace is one spreadsheet. Codes can be scanned or tapped. Date fills itself.

scenarios.name: Trip book
scenarios.description: Travel capture. Trip holds the journey and tickets. Places holds visits and short videos. Each workspace is one spreadsheet. Codes can be scanned or tapped. Date fills itself.
